reasons: Quantity differs: Datadog docker.io.read_bytes counts bytes read per container, but the candidate uses container.blockio.io_service_time_recursive, which measures I/O service time (ns), not bytes.
Unit differs: Datadog bytes versus OTel ns; no scaling would make service time equal a byte count.
The candidate filters on operation="read" and wraps the metric in rate(), so it yields a rate of time per device series rather than the bytes-read total the widget shows.
Grouping uses container_image_name, which is not verified against dataset labels (none observed for this metric), so the by-docker_image grouping is unsupported.
The correct outcome is blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING, because no OTel metric in the provided definitions measures bytes read; the candidate translated instead.
